scene_goal: Identify and resolve the blocking defect through systematic investigation

participants.name: Debugger
participants.description: Systematic investigator reproducing, isolating, and fixing the unknown failure

participants.name: System
participants.description: The failing system, code, or environment under investigation

participants.name: User
participants.description: Person experiencing the failure, providing symptoms and context

action_to_complete.predicate: identify root cause and apply verified fix

constraints: Change one thing at a time
output_format: Concise investigation log: hypothesis, test, evidence, conclusion. Final answer: root cause, fix, verification.
